gaps.cause: printed section difference (bond/loan proceeds among budget resources)
gaps.explanation: Nothing is missing and nothing is counted twice. Detail governmental revenue 4,595,125 = statement 3,155,125 (p5 Total revenues: General 1,523,258 + Street 740,981 + Sales Tax 648,179 + Debt Service 149,299 + Economic Development 14,301 + Keno 79,107) + 1,440,000. The 1,440,000 is detail 80, Street Fund 'Bond/loan proceeds' 1,440,000, printed on the p13 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Street Fund among RESOURCES (INFLOWS) (Total resources (inflows) 2,180,981 = Street revenue 740,981 + 1,440,000). The governmental funds statement prints the same 1,440,000 in the Street Fund column under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), 'Bond/loan proceeds' (p6), so the JSON has it as debt_proceeds 1,440,000, not as a receipt. Same money, one detail line; it is the only detail line holding the debt proceeds, so it is not removed or relabelled (the schedule prints it as a resource). Without the 1,440,000 the detail revenue equals the statement to the dollar (gap exactly 1,440,000).
